title: Using Generative Artificial Intelligence Creatively in the Classroom and Research: Examples and Lessons Learned

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative illustration and discussion of occupational stereotypes (e.g., gender, race, and setting) using a single DALL-E 3 generated image of a 'meteorologist at work'.
Theoretical discussion of educational and professional inequities caused by large language models being predominantly optimized for Standard American English, which disadvantages non-native speakers.
Literature review and discussion regarding the leakage of biases in Earth systems applications through historically biased physical science datasets used for training models.
